A finding names the screen, the rule and an example. The full manual pass (screen readers, large text) is parked until there is a reason for it (DT235).

flows.about: JOURNEY (0.2.105 and 0.2.106, boards Stories72 and Stories74, DT126 and DT126c; Milan 25 October 13:48 to 15:12): Recipes is one list under one bar, no tabs. One search over the title, the foods (in any of the pilot's languages) and the cook; Made by and Kitchen as drop-downs with counts; chips that stack; a sort; the line that says what is shown of what. Idle, the list is grouped by who made it, two rows per group and a line for the rest. A recipe shared without a name is found by the search and counted under A member without a name; a recipe of yours shared without your name says so on its tile.
